items.summary: Centrifuge proposes letting eligible CFG holders subscribe for company shares at one CFG per share as it explores a token-to-equity conversion.

items.title: Kaito Launches Pulse Social Layer for X
items.summary: Kaito launches Pulse and Aura, bringing verified reputation and activity to "social trading" via the X timeline.

items.title: South Korea Blocks Polymarket Over Gambling Concerns
items.summary: South Korea blocked Polymarket over illegal gambling concerns, joining more than 30 jurisdictions restricting the prediction market.

items.title: Getting Started with Bankless MCP
items.summary: Bankless MCP wires AI workspaces like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor into the full Bankless content archive.

items.title: Omnichain Launchpad Printr Shuts Down, Cancels Token Launch And Airdrop
items.summary: Printr said it will cease all operations by Aug. 31 and will not hold the token generation event or airdrop it had promised. The launchpad raised $4.5 million last October and collected 84% of its lifetime fees in a single month.

items.title: Stripe Is Acquiring AI Router OpenRouter for +$8B
items.summary: OpenRouter's founder built OpenSea, then built "Stripe for AI." Now Stripe is buying the company in a massive deal.
